gameDescriptionHtml:
Become a Mighty Captain in a Age of sail naval combat game, set in all of the Seven Seas! Sail the entire world: conquering, plundering, exploring and trading along the way! Gather your crew, ready your ship, hoist your sails and enter a world of swashbuckling and piracy!

Terror of the Seven Seas is the pirate game that you have always dreamed of. Combining ship combat and sailing with massive living open world, full of exploration and adventures.

So what are you waiting for? Scroll up and wishlist!

Game Features

  • BE THE CAPTAIN YOU ALWAYS WANTED TO BE – Become a Legendary Pirate, live a life of freedom and plunder yourself a mountain of gold. Become a Naval Officer and serve your king and raise a mighty fleet and conquer the world for the glory of your nation! Become a Wealthy Trader and run your own treasure fleets to carry unimaginable wealth to all corners of the world and battle the pirates trying to plunder your wealth! Become a World Known Explorer and find lost temples and artifacts, hunt whales and sea monsters. Maybe you will even find the dream of every conquistador: El Dorado!
  • EXPLORE THE MASSIVE OPEN WORLD – Enjoy and explore the massive handbuilt version of Earth and sail all the Seven Seas and continents it provides. From warmth of the Caribbean into the cold winds of artic. See the bustle and industry of Europe and sail the trade winds to Asia. Visit, trade, conquer over 120 ports. Fully uninterrupted open world, follow the sail winds of Magellan and circumnavigate the globe!
  • NAVAL COMBAT BAR NONE – Sink your enemies with a wide array of weapons: from cannonballs to mortars, to even explosive barrels and fireships! Use skills such as anchor turns and explosive cannonballs to aid you in combat. Weaken your enemies and board them for extra rewards. Maneuver your ships with the wind and devastate your enemies with raking shots. Command your fleet to aid you in battle.
  • BUILD A MIGHTY ARMADA – Over 30 detailed period correct ships, all the way from 6 gun sloops to massive 160 gun Man’O’Wars! Including such classics as: Wasa, Victory, Constitution, Endeavour, Santisima Trinidad.
  • LIVING BREATHING WORLD – See the trade galleons carrying vast wealth and the pirates who hunt them in search of gold. Fierce pirate hunters seeking for justice. Navies warring on the shores and seas for the control. Sea monster lurking below the surface, looking for their next prey. Nations creating alliances and starting wars. Witness, cause and join massive naval battles.
  • TRAIN YOUR CAPTAIN – Gain experience and rank and use them to gather mighty crew, loyal allies and gain special skills to offer you in advantage inside and outside the combat.
  • SEE THE WONDERS OF THE SEVEN SEAS – From fiery volcanoes, sunken treasure and ancient temples, into scary occult and plenty more! Find treasures, allies and legendary equipment hidden inside them.
  • ROARING SEAS – Dynamic weather and time of day offer ever changing environment. From calm clear sunrises into fierce ship sized waves, howling winds and pouring rains. Witness mighty thunder storms and battle fierce tornadoes.
  • CHOOSE YOUR ALLIANCES – Enlist with 14 different from factions all over the world! Affect their destinies and rewrite the history to your liking.
  • CUSTOMIZE YOUR SHIPS – Gather upgrades from enemies, find them from treasure or plunder them from merchants and use them to enhance your ship and crew into your liking: Use copper plated hulls to improve your ship’s speed. Equip bronze cannons to increase accuracy and damage of your cannonballs. Customize sails that will forever symbolize the might of your fleet. And tens of more ways to turn your ships into one that you have always dreamed of!
